facts.fact: Automated programmatic channels are expected to account for 89.3% of global display ad spend in 2025 (per eMarketer, cited by StackAdapt).
facts.quote: Automated programmatic channels are expected to account for [89.3% of global display ad spend](http://content-na1.emarketer.com/worldwide-programmatic-ad-spending-2025) this year

facts.fact: Automated programmatic channels are expected to receive 96.8% of new ad dollars in 2025.
facts.quote: with 96.8% of new ad dollars flowing into these channels

facts.fact: RTB auctions happen in the time it takes a page to load, usually within one-tenth of a second.
facts.quote: This all happens in the time it takes a page to load—usually within one-tenth of a second.

facts.fact: AI-powered bidding is described as able to reduce cost-per-acquisition by up to 30%, per a claim attributed to Google.
facts.quote: [Google reports](https://www.numberanalytics.com/blog/7-ai-stats-ad-targeting-success) that AI-powered bidding strategies can reduce cost-per-acquisition by up to 30%.

facts.fact: Real-time bidding is the automated process by which ad impressions are bought and sold in real time, with an auction occurring each time a user visits a website or opens an app and the highest bid winning.
facts.quote: RTB is the automated process through which ad impressions are bought and sold in real time. Each time a user visits a website or opens an app, an instantaneous auction occurs.

facts.fact: AI models assess historical and real-time auction data to estimate the clearing price of each impression, per StackAdapt's description of AI bidding.
facts.quote: AI models assess historical and real-time auction data to estimate the clearing price of each impression.
